relationships.subject: KCC2
relationships.evidence_quote: Importantly, spinal KCC2 impairment triggers pain hypersensitivity through α2δ-1-coupled NMDA receptors.

key_findings: KCC2 inhibition with VU0463271 potentiates presynaptic and postsynaptic NMDA receptor activity specifically in VGluT2 excitatory dorsal horn neurons, not in VGAT inhibitory neurons.
KCC2 impairment causes pain hypersensitivity via alpha2delta-1-bound NMDA receptors, as it is lost in Cacna2d1 KO mice and blocked by the alpha2delta-1 C-terminus mimicking peptide or pregabalin.
